description:
Creates a new file on the local filesystem and writes the provided content.

Usage:
- This tool only creates new files. It will reject any path that already exists.
- Use the edit tool for any change to an existing file.
- Parent directories will be created automatically if they don't exist.
- In a registered writable knowledge directory, provide Markdown body content only. Locus generates the required frontmatter, updates the knowledge index, and reports every generated field plus the final content start line.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to write

content.description: The full file content, or Markdown body only when creating a registered knowledge document
